dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the silhouette from the mid-section toward a pointed posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a subtle asymmetrical expansion on the left mid-section.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity consistent with a uniform mid-tone slate grey.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency distribution of darker-pixel clusters concentrated along the central longitudinal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between the darker medial axis and the lighter lateral margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Single high-contrast dark aperture (blowhole) positioned at the anterior midline.
